_note: Shared by sidelineiq-agents (src/ledger/copy.ts) and sidelineiq-frontend (lib/ledger-copy.ts). The two modules are byte-identical and this file is what stops them drifting: copy it to both repos together. copy_version must equal LEDGER_COPY_VERSION in both. Counsel edits land in copy.ts, then re-record.
